concepts.name: ApplicationOutputEnvelope
concepts.meaning: A reversible path prefix and receipt location around an unchanged compiled project.

concepts.name: LayoutSemanticPreservation
concepts.meaning: Only output paths and envelope identity vary; source selections, native module bytes, relative imports and outcomes do not.

concepts.name: ExplicitLayoutSelection
concepts.meaning: The caller selects the existing layout parameter independently of architecture and numeric realization.
